h1: Custom Full Color Buttons for Bulk Orders
metaTitle: Custom Full Color Buttons | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom full color buttons for your next event or promotion. Perfect for bulk branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Full color buttons let you reproduce logos, photos, and detailed artwork with sharp, vibrant results. Unlike single- or two-color imprints, full color gives you the freedom to use gradients, multiple hues, and photographic images. This makes them ideal for event giveaways, campaign pins, or retail packaging where visual impact matters. Choose from round buttons, button cards, or lapel pins in various sizes to match your promotional goals.
heroAltText: Custom full color buttons with vibrant printed logos and artwork, perfect for bulk promotional orders.
